         }

         worker->busy = 0;
 
-#ifdef BSAL_NODE_ENABLE_LOAD_REPORTING
+#ifdef BSAL_NODE_ENABLE_INSTRUMENTATION
         end_time = bsal_timer_get_nanoseconds();
 
         elapsed_nanoseconds = end_time - start_time;
